rationale_evidence.statement: Worked AI-reasoning example: an agent searching for whether an API supports OAuth and finding nothing must not collapse to 'No' but must classify among four non-collapsible outcomes -- Unknown (no documentation found), True absence (architecture explicitly forbids OAuth), Historical absence (OAuth removed in version 3), Future absence (OAuth planned but not implemented) -- via a proposed pipeline Observation -> No evidence found -> Abhava classifier -> Determine absence type -> Reason.

Represent the structure of the absence.'
